headline: Israeli President H.E Reuven Rivlin Visits Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi, India
story:
Israeli President H.E Reuven Rivlin Visits Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi Pujya Anandswarup Swami and senior sadhus traditionally welcomed Israeli President H.E Reuven Rivlin with a garland of flowers. Accompanying the Israeli President was the First Lady of Israel, Nechama Rivlin, who was traditionally welcomed with a garland of flowers by senior members of Swaminarayan Akshardham.

In addition, members of the Israeli delegation to India joined the visit. After marveling at the Mayur Dwar (Peacock Gate), the President and First Lady viewed the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir where they offered their respects and admired the Mandir’s art and architecture.

Touched by the universal messages of peace and harmony, they also offered their best wishes for world peace. Sharing his sentiments at Akshardham, President of the State of Israel, H.E. Reuven Rivlin, wrote, “Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: May all love thee prosper.

May all be blessed.” Sharing her experience of Akshardham, First Lady of Israel, Nechama Rivlin, wrote, “On a nice and pleasant evening, we came to visit the Akshardham Temple and we stay speechless because of the beauty of this important and divine place.”

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj sanctifies a plot of land acquired for the construction of a mandir
options.story:
Swamishri sanctified a plot of land acquired for the construction of a mandir.

Showers his immortalizing words on an audience of bhaktas. Visits the Khambhada village. Visits the new mandir construction site, Dholka. Welcomed by Haka Bapu. Devotionally absorbed in the darshan of Harikrishna Maharaj in the mandir shrine. After being garlanded during the welcome. Blesses bhaktas in jovial mood. In a jovial, illustrious and attentive mood. A touch of divine care and informality. Crowning a peacock as a symbol of appreciation after a presentation by sadhus. Listens attentively to a tale of sorrow and pain from an old blind bhakta. Consoling and reassuring. Blesses with sanctified flowers. "Always see the virtues of all".

options.headline: Interacts with children
options.story:
"We belong to Akshardham"

After the puja was completed, as today was Children's and Youth Day, the children and youths began a question and answer session. In it a child asked, "Bhagwatcharan Swami keeps saying, 'You are from Anand.' So are you from Anand?"

Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "We belong to Akshardham... Look, there have been countless births. All that is perishable. You too will have to know it like that."

A second question was asked: "Everyone comes running so early in the morning to have your darshan, so what is it that is in you?"

Pointing to God installed above, Swamishri said, "I have left everything to God. We do as He likes, and everyone follows."

"You must not be taking the medicine"

A devotee came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. A member of his family had psoriasis. Swamishri had suggested medicine two or three times. After that, when Swamishri was in Paris, he had phoned again: "It is not making any difference, so what should we do now?" Swamishri had said then, "You must not be taking the medicine..."

Today the devotee came and, holding his earlobes, said, "Yes, Swami! It was just as you said. We were mixing everything, allopathy, the homeopathy you had given and so on. And that too not properly... it kept starting and stopping. Once, saying 'It isn't getting better,' we got tired and stopped it altogether. But when we heard you say, 'You must not be taking the medicine...', we started the medicine properly and it was cured."

If we too take properly the medicine Swamishri has shown for curing the disease of birth and death, we can become free of that disease.

Interacts with children. Performs morning puja. Greets all with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. During the assembly. Offers thal to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Blesses the morning satsang assembly. Children present before Bapa. Gives darshan to bhaktas. Bhagvatprasad Swami addresses the evening assembly. A drama presentation by youths during the evening satsang assembly. Pujya Swayamprakash Swami (Doctor Swami) addresses the evening satsang assembly. Youths perform a traditional dance in the evening satsang assembly. Children play a game during the assembly. Children doing mala before Bapa. Children perform a traditional dance in the evening satsang assembly. Receives a garland from Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami. Children during the assembly. Bhaktas during the assembly.
